{{Quote|She commands a phalanx for a rival syndic, one who doesn't approve of the changes I'm encouraging. And I know she wouldn't approve of you, either.|Assistant Syndic Soontir Fel|<ref name="Force Heretic II" />}}
A '''Phalanx''', also referred to as a '''Household Phalanx''' or '''Colonial Phalanx''', was the primary division within the military of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]], separate from the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet]]. There were 28 Phalanxes, one to defend each of the colony worlds, while those assigned to the headquarters of the Ruling Families were referred to as Household Phalanxes, as opposed to Colonial Phalanxes.

==Description==
{{Quote|Shawnkyr is a true member of a renegade phalanx, sir. She would not stay behind if I ordered her to.|Jagged Fel, to Soontir Fel|<ref name="Dark Journey">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref>}}
[[File:ChissAscendancy.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Phalanxes defended twenty-eight central Chiss Ascendancy colonies.]]
A Phalanx,<ref name="The Chiss" /> also referred to as a Household Phalanx<ref name="Vision of the Future" /> or Colonial Phalanx, was the primary division within the military of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]], separate from the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet]], which was deemed a foreign-affairs asset rather than a military one. There were 28 Phalanxes, one to defend each of<ref name="The Chiss" /> the central<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> colony worlds, and command of each Phalanx typically fell to an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] appointed by the [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] of one of the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]].<ref name="The Chiss" /> Phalanxes assigned to the headquarters of the Ruling Families were referred to as Household Phalanxes, as opposed to Colonial Phalanxes.<ref name="TUR" /> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naporar]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Nuruodo family]], held the ranking authority in all matters related to the Household and Colonial Phalanxes.<ref name="The Essential Atlas" /> In times of crisis, the Defense Fleet would call upon the forces of nearby Phalanxes.<ref name="The Chiss" />

==History==
{{Quote|We are Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx. We live only to serve him. And through him, serve the Chiss.|[[Kres'ten'tarthi]] "Stent" to [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]|<ref name="Vision of the Future" />}}
[[File:VanguardSquadron-DJ.jpg|thumb|300px|left|Vanguard Squadron from Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx during the Battle of Hapes.]]
During his tenure as Syndic, [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrawn," of the [[Mitth family/Legends|Eighth Ruling Family]] commanded his own [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx|personal Household Phalanx]].<ref name="Vision of the Future" /> With his fleet of Imperial Star Destroyers, the Imperial forces worked alongside the native forces of his loyal Household Phalanx. The territory conquered in these campaigns became the basis of a new power, the [[Empire of the Hand]], a successor to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> who formed an uneasy relationship with the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. Though his people considered Thrawn a renegade, many [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]]s secretly supported his actions, believing his proactive stance ultimately kept the Chiss people safe.<ref name="TUR" /> While the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]] feigned obliviousness to this alliance, the average citizen was well aware of it.<ref name="Vision of the Future" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ina'ganet'nuruodo]], core name "Ganet," was in charge of a [[Unidentified phalanx|phalanx]] loyal to a [[Unidentified syndic (Ina'ganet'nuruodo)|syndic]] that was opposed to the policies of [[Assistant Syndic]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]].<ref name="Force Heretic II" />
